review_method: Single-analyst line-by-line source inspection; independently unreviewed. Span categories are descriptive dominant-line responsibilities, not causal attribution.
policy: Deduplicate file/line tokens across all selected blocks; exclude policy and logging from the five-row primary table; record all omitted-case reasons.

blocks.note: Operand binding and nested-transpose branch only; omit identity/scatter/bitcast and dot branches.
Common broadcast operand and descriptor capture, counted once.
Shared elementwise sinking algorithm includes scalar expansion and generic elementwise/user handling beyond the two TEPL binary/equal-map specializations. Configuration dispatch is policy.
Local permutation predicate; includes the additional sort case. Subset predicate is short-circuited for the selected reverse/transpose cases and is not expanded.
Scalar broadcast through a permutation: retain user traversal and mutation; no iota, broadcast-composition, or unrelated reshape branches.
Nested broadcast descriptor composition and replacement.
Reduce operand, init, output shape, dimensions and combiner capture. Layout-sensitive dispatch is separate policy; unrelated tuple/trivial-reduce rewrites omitted.
Local scalar-zero predicate and its effective-scalar predicate; scalar type switching is retained. General primitive/literal library routines are not expanded.
Only negate/sum commutation. Floating-type and zero-init checks remain legality; scalar/combiner assumptions are built into the TEPL sum dialect.
MergeReduces helper plus actual matching/combiner-equivalence caller. Both retained TEPL reduction-composition cases share this code.
Reduction-through-transpose branch includes general output-transpose correction; TEPL case is rank two/vector output. Fanout/unconditional-rewrite option is policy.
Reverse operand capture; layout sensitivity is policy. Trivial-dimension elimination is another rewrite and omitted.
Nested-reverse symmetric difference, including empty-result deletion; shared by fixed and general TEPL cases.
Generic binary elementwise commutation with a scalar broadcast, both operand orders. TEPL selects addition with the scalar on one side; side-effect/opcode restrictions are retained.
Shared HandleDot entry/capture only, not other dot rewrites or sharding checks. Layout policy excluded.
Complete local ConstructToDotMaps and ConstructFromDotMaps axis-map algorithms, once globally, including both input maps and inverse maps.

General nested-dot reassociation, including batch/contract maps and optional output transpose; source flop heuristic is excluded. TEPL is ordinary matrix multiplication only. No unrelated HandleDot branches included.
Shared reverse/broadcast operand selection and dimension maps. Selector also mentions pad, but the pad algorithm is excluded.
Reverse-specific map partition and construction; shape-ratio threshold and threshold multiplier are source policy.
Broadcast-specific contraction map rewriting and reduction construction; optional residual broadcast retained. Threshold adjustment is policy.
Common new-dot construction and actual visitor replacement. Flop threshold and logging excluded; pad-specific source body is not selected.
Parameter-like profitability/layout preference predicate, kept in excluded-policy accounting.
Precision-configuration propagation, outside the ideal-algebraic TEPL profile; excluded rather than credited as a saving.
Canonical transpose(dot) branch, appropriate for the rank-two TEPL case; exclude the separate arbitrary noncanonical-dot branch, and parameter/precision preference policy.
Operand and output-permutation swap helper and call site. Parameter placement gate and precision policy excluded; general batching permutation retained.
Local batch-major/contracting-minor normalization, shared by no-contraction and strength-reduction helpers; general transpose path retained.
No-contracting-dimension multiply rewrite and dispatch. General broadcasting retained; preferred-type conversions and feature/precision gates excluded.
Complete local predicate used by dot-to-reduce dispatch.
Product/reduction construction, rank-general outer-dimension broadcasting, and caller; scalar f32 dot specialization in TEPL. Preferred-type/precision and CPU strength-reduction policy excluded.
Local zero-init sum-reduction builder. General scalar-add computation construction is treated as a primitive library dependency, like TEPL sum semantics.
Convert reduced batch dimensions to contracting dimensions, including optional remaining reduction; TEPL fixes ranks and reduces one batch axis. Feature flags excluded.

Only multiply-constant-into-broadcast rewrite, including original literal/nonconstant matching. TEPL captures a scalar C and proves the more general algebraic equation; numerical fast-math gating is excluded, not counted as a saving.
Both-input transpose removal helper and dispatch, retaining general canonical batch handling and both operand orders. Rank-two TEPL specialization; precision helper separately excluded.
Reduce-free-output-dimension into dot operands, including complete local dot maps via shared helper; original flop/profitability gate excluded. TEPL selects a rank-two free dimension.
Only reduction of original base-tensor axes through broadcast: mapping legality, surviving axes, and replacement. Replication-count reduction is a different branch and excluded.
Equal-rank/equal-element-count broadcast to transpose; inverse permutation is attribute reasoning. Earlier broadcast-to-reshape branch excluded.
Complete unit-insertion elision branch, including original-value-recovery bookkeeping. General insertion positions exceed the TEPL rank-one specialization. Shape/HLO APIs remain library dependencies.

Drop degenerate operand dimensions and update broadcast map. Feature/layout gates excluded as policy. Original source combines feature gating and shape legality in one if; the two lines are assigned separately. General unit positions exceed the TEPL specialization.

Complete insertion-only transpose-of-broadcast helper and actual transpose caller. Sorted-map legality retained; layout-sensitive policy excluded. TEPL permits unsorted axis maps and supplies an alternative general-rank shape expression. No unrelated HandleTranspose branches.

Reverse through unit-inserting reshape, including the complete transformation-specific CountElementsLessThan helper once. General insertion/reverse positions exceed the rank-one TEPL specialization. Shared reverse input capture counted once via the base block.
